goal: Prevent descriptor wallet rescans from silently missing transactions and showing incorrect balances
Ensure transactions in the same block that precede pool-expanding transactions are properly detected
agreement: Substantive support across multiple reviewers with no open objections
Concept approval despite rescanning performance trade-offs (achow101)
Concept approval while confirming lookahead bug validity (molnard)
Support for re-check cleanliness and approach (polespinasa)
Objections around intra-block child spends and cascading receives resolved via retry loop (molnard, jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes silent transaction omissions and wrong balances during rescans and restores
Affects users restoring wallets or importing descriptors when payments expand the look-ahead pool
